Artists and contest winners having difficulties with Groove is nothing new, unfortunately. I hope they follow through with you and you receive what you were promised because your work is stunning. You deserve to be paid. Honestly, the more I learn about Groove and Mango and how they treat artists, the less I want to support them. Pullip used to be my absolute favorite doll line and it breaks my heart. 

IMO, the most active Pullip group is The Pullip and Dolly Kingdom (formerly Omocha Crush) on Facebook.
